sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow; antennae, labrum, legs and body white; mandibles dark brown. Head and body rather hairy. Body length 4.60—4.90 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, wider anteriorly; sides weakly incurved behind the middle; frontal protuberance broadly rounded, its anterior margin not concave (length to mandible base 1.13—1.20 mm, length to frontal protuberance 1.10—1.17 mm, maximum width 0.97—1.00 mm). Antennae 14-segmented; segment 3 shorter than segment 2; segment 4 shortest. Labrum subrectangular, anterior margin deeply concave, lateral margins without teeth (length 0.28—0.31 mm, width 0.25 mm). Mandibles rod-like, weakly incurved apically; slightly longer than the head (length 1.27 mm, left mandible length/head length index 1.06—1.12). Postmentum rod-like, short (length 0.47—0.59 mm, maximum width 0.33 mm, waist width 0.27 mm); the waist posteriorly situated. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped; anterior margin slightly concave at the middle (length 0.17 mm, width 0.50 mm).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow; antennae, labrum, legs and thorax white; abdomen semitransparent. Head and body rather densely hairy. Body length 4.40—5.00 mm. Head capsule subcircular, wider than long (length to labral apex 1.10—1.17 mm, length to mandible base 0.73—0.80 mm, maximum width 0.87—0.90 mm). Antennae 14-segmented; segment 3 shorter than segment 2; segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus strongly inflated, slightly more than half as long as wide (length 0.25—0.27 mm, width 0.43—0.47 mm). Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, anterior margin without a notch (length 0.20 mm, width 0.50 mm). The original notes that the worker closely resembles A. kashmirensis, differing in the more inflated postclypeus which is more than half as long as wide (only half as long in the latter).

note: Adapted from the entry in Chhotani (1997), original in English; soldier and worker are described, the alate is recorded as unknown in the original; synonymy list, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated.
